correctness.rationale: Symbolic exact fold factorization fixes two equilibria, the unique physical upper preimage, invariant semi-attracting interval and extinction outside. Reciprocal increments prove n(x_n-rho)->(1-rho)^2/rho. Below fold F_epsilon <= (1-epsilon)x ensures extinction; the normalized displacement has the exact scalar recurrence whose arctangent increments give full/half/no passage times and the upper-preimage derivative crossover. Verification code was actually executed and agrees for nine profiles and six further tests; those finite tests are not used as infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The previously published fold threshold, classical square-root saddle-node slowing and arctangent normal form are expressly acknowledged as known. The inspected GAL full text does not provide the exact global upper-density cutoff or its fold-preimage-scale passage profile. Relevant earlier finite-time scaling and Allee-basin works do not supply this joint claim for the GAL map. Abstract-only 2025 sources leave residual historical-priority risk.
residual_risks: Generic fold passage asymptotics are classical and could imply the local coefficient after a trivial parameter substitution; only the global survival/preimage crossover is claimed as potentially new.
The full 2025 Corral work and complete technical appendices of the 2025 Martin–Tang–Chialvo work were not materially inspected.
Unindexed or differently phrased preimage-crossover results may exist; no independent priority review.

value.rationale: The explicit survival basin at the biologically natural positive-equilibrium fold identifies a sharp high-density overcrowding extinction boundary. Its O(sqrt(epsilon)) initial-condition crossover produces a quantitative extinction-delay profile distinguishing long and absent apparent persistence, a natural observable for this map that is not given by the already known existence threshold or generic fold exponent.
